newsitem.title: EGYPT: Police kill four suspected militants in Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Police kill four suspected militants in Egypt.

text.p: Egyptian police shot dead four suspected Moslem militants in a gun battle in the southern province of Minya, security sources said on Wednesday.
They said the incident took place on Tuesday night when police went to a village near the provincial capital Minya city after they were tipped that fugitive militants were hiding out there.

Police in Minya believe the dead men were members of the military wing of the militant al-Gama'a al-Islamiya (Islamic Group), which has been fighting to overthrow the government and set up a strict Islamic state.
No casualties were reported on the police side.
More than 1,000 people, mostly militants and police, have been killed in political violence in Egypt since militants took up arms in 1992.
